answer: Use stake-weighted sortition: each epoch a random committee is drawn from locked stakes, so a Sybil farm cannot buy a seat without splitting its stake into many weak tickets. The committee keeps a crystal-clear public log of every attestation, and any agent may whisper a fraud proof against a forged entry. A proven forgery burns the forger's stake, and the umber audit trail marks its whole lineage untrusted. Forging many identities costs linearly more stake while detection costs one proof, so mass Sybil creation loses money.
